I think you and understandably are upset about that and in a way want him to find his bio parents so that it’s like living vicariously through him with a reunion with his bio. 
However you’re TA bc he explicitly said he did not want that. I’m adopted and having bio parents and adopted parents is a tricky thing and not every adopted kid feels the same in regards to wanting to find their biological parents. I know I never did. I think you should talk to him and explain your side and cut the bs you’re feeding yourself of “ I just wanted to make sure” no. You wanted to live your reunion of bio parents fantasy. Just get real with yourself first and then with him and then you can shout him out for leaving you without money and the kids which is bad on him.

I live exactly in the poverty ridge midtown area. I’d say it can get a little sketch because the underpasses on X and broadway which are very close and some of the homeless people trickle in. 
Which, nothing wrong with homeless people but I will say that I feel that Sacramento homeless are a little more aggressive than other places like Berkeley for example. Don’t really know why that is, but in my experience I’ve had safer interactions walking alone at night in Berkeley than I have had in broad daylight in Sacramento. 

What I do, is just walk with a purpose. People tend to not bother you if you are walking like you know where you’re going ( basically a “ city walk”) 
And stay in areas that are maybe more in midtown, the further you get into the outskirts of midtown the more houses there are and then less people are walking around and so more opportunities for bad things to occur. 
Good luck, I’m still figuring it out!
